Subject: Pilot window relief: webhook shim delay & credit/top-up request

Jonas / Marissa,

Quick update from our engineering side: we hit an unexpected blocker with the webhook shim (our vendor's library doesn't preserve the signature header when batching events). That means our devs are blocked from wiring the onboarding flow to your sandbox — the connector is stuck in local QA and we can't complete end-to-end tests.

We've invested the sprint but need a bit more runway to finish the shim fix and validate retries. With the current pilot credits and the demo booked for next Wednesday, we're worried about missing the window. Two asks:

- Can Redwood provide a 2-week pilot extension to keep our sandbox active while we finish the shim work?
- Would you consider a small credits top-up (equivalent to ~40k tokens) so we can run extended end-to-end tests once the shim is fixed?

Attachments: integration_logs.zip (sample logs showing signature strip), brief vendor note.

Thanks — we want to keep momentum, just need a little safety net so the demo isn't a false negative.

Lauren Mitchell
Program Lead, Partnerships
BrightLeaf Health

1) Is the demo next Wednesday still fixed on your side or are you seeing pressure to move it?
2) Can your engineering team confirm whether the vendor patch is expected within 48h or if this is a multi-sprint fix?

If it's a short patch (<=48h) we can likely approve a 1-week extension and a modest token bump to cover re-tests. If it's longer, we should consider 2 weeks + a slightly larger top-up and I will submit for manager approval.

I appreciate the heads-up — will coordinate and get back to you by EOD.
